conventions.rates: Percent (3.2 means 3.2%) unless the row names another unit (head taxes in USD).
conventions.base: "wages" = earned income/compensation; "AGI" = state adjusted gross income; "taxable income" = state taxable income.
conventions.censusGeoid: 7-digit Census place GEOID for cities, 5-digit county FIPS for counties (2024 Census Gazetteer). Multi-county districts list countyFips.
conventions.nonresidentRate: Rate on a nonresident working there; 0 where nonresidents are not taxed locally.

states.kind: occupational license tax on wages (cities, a few counties)
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: About two dozen cities (Birmingham, Bessemer, Gadsden 2%, etc.) and Macon County; new ones barred without legislative act.

states.kind: occupational privilege (head) tax, flat dollars per month
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.unit: USD per employee per month (employee share)
states.note: Denver, Glendale, Greenwood Village, Sheridan; Aurora repealed its OPT effective 2025-01-01. Employers pay a matching or separate amount.

states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)

states.kind: county local income tax (LIT), piggyback on state AGI
states.source: https://www.in.gov/dor/files/dn01.pdf
states.note: All 92 counties; typicalRate is the median, avgRate the unweighted mean of DN#1 (Oct 1, 2026). TF share of AGI 0.62%.

states.kind: school district income surtax (percent of state tax liability)
states.source: https://revenue.iowa.gov/media/4382/download (2025 surtax list); https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.unit: percent of Iowa income tax liability
states.note: rateMin/rateMax are surtax percentages of state tax, not of income; avgRate is TF % of AGI. Also county EMS surtax authority (rarely used).

states.kind: local intangibles tax on interest/dividend income
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Most localities have repealed it; no wage tax allowed.

states.kind: occupational license tax on wages and net profits (cities, counties, school districts)
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Single-jurisdiction max ~2.25% (Lexington); Louisville resident 2.2%, nonresident 1.45%. City and county levies can stack with credits.

states.kind: county income tax, piggyback on state taxable income (all 23 counties + Baltimore City)
states.source: https://www.marylandcomptroller.gov/content/dam/mdcomp/md/state-payroll/memos/2026/2026-maryland-state-and-local-withholding-information.pdf
states.note: avgRate is unweighted mean of statutory rates; TF effective share of AGI 2.40%. Cap raised to 3.30% from tax year 2026. Nonresidents pay 2.25% state special nonresident tax instead.

states.kind: city income tax (Uniform City Income Tax Act), 24 cities
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Standard 1% resident / 0.5% nonresident; Detroit 2.4/1.2, Grand Rapids and Saginaw 1.5/0.75, Highland Park 2/1.

states.kind: earnings tax (Kansas City and St. Louis only)
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Voter renewal required every five years.

states.source: N.J.S.A. 40:48C-14 et seq.; https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)

states.kind: NYC resident income tax; Yonkers resident surcharge and nonresident earnings tax
states.source: https://www.tax.ny.gov/pdf/publications/withholding/nys50_t_nyc.pdf; https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: NYC 3.078-3.876% graduated; Yonkers 16.75% of state tax (resident), 0.5% wages (nonresident). MCTMT employer payroll tax in MTA district (0.11-0.60%) not counted.

states.kind: municipal income tax (~600 cities/villages) + school district income tax (~200 districts)
states.source: https://tax.ohio.gov/researcher/tax-analysis/tax-data-series/municipal-income-taxes (Ohio Dept. of Taxation municipal income tax rates); https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.unit: percent of wages (municipal); percent of Ohio taxable income or earned income (school districts)

states.kind: regional/county income taxes (Portland area) + transit payroll taxes
states.source: https://www.portland.gov/revenue/personal-tax; https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.unit: percent of Oregon taxable income above threshold
states.note: Metro SHS 1% and Multnomah PFA 1.5%/3.0% above high-income thresholds; Portland Arts Tax $35 head tax; TriMet and Lane Transit employer payroll taxes (~0.8%); statewide 0.1% employee transit tax is state-level.

states.kind: earned income tax (EIT, municipalities + school districts) and Local Services Tax
states.source: https://www.phila.gov/services/payments-assistance-taxes/business-taxes/wage-tax-employers/; https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Most combined resident EIT 1% (0.5% muni + 0.5% school), higher in distressed or home-rule cities (Pittsburgh 3%, Scranton 3.4%, Philadelphia 3.735% resident / 3.425% nonresident from July 1, 2026).

states.kind: city service fee (flat dollars per week/pay period) in a few cities
states.source: https://taxfoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Local-Income-Taxes-A-Primer-2023.pdf (Tables 1-4; avgRate = local income tax collections as % of AGI, 2020 Census data)
states.note: Charleston, Huntington, Wheeling, Parkersburg and others charge flat user fees on people working in the city (Charleston ~$6 per pay period per TF).
